entities.summary: Mohammad Hameed Shahid is a Pakistani short story writer, novelist and literary critic. He is well known for his Urdu fiction writings. He was awarded the Award with Tamgha-e-Imtiaz in 2016, one of the highest literary honour given by the Government of Pakistan.
